The '''Grand Computer''' was installed within the [[Jedi Library]] of the [[Lost City of the Jedi]], a subterranean [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]] station and secret [[City/Legends|city]] built by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of old on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Most of the library's records were in files contained within that master [[Computer/Legends|computer]], although others were handwritten on manuscripts or printed in [[Book/Legends|books]]. The Grand Computer was thought to be exhaustive, collecting the knowledge of all civilizations and the history of all [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and [[Moon/Legends|moons]] inhabited by [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Millennia after its creation, the computer was updated by the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] caretakers of the Lost City of the Jedi, who regularly visited the surface to collect new information.

In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], the Grand Computer was accidentally destroyed by one of the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] who was trapped inside the Library by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] forces along with group of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial agents]] led by the so-called [[Supreme Prophet]] of the Dark Side [[Rajah Ubooki|Kadann]].
